name: Flea
tagline: the ricochet: time the bounce, bank the speed
summary: The ricochet. It crawls at 40 u/s on its own; speed comes from bouncing off mass. A hull contact reflects it instead of resetting it, and a press of RT inside the window round the contact is a perfect bounce: ×1.35 and a growing chain. Between bounces it coasts almost ballistically, so you aim the next bounce with the nose. Crouch with LT and release to hop when no mass is near.

spec.v: RT at contact: perfect bounce · LT crouch, release to hop
timing windows and earned speed: Haste, ULTRAKILL, Peglin, parry games

fantasy: A pinball that chose its own flippers. Every wall is a launch pad if you hit the button on the beat; miss it and you dribble.
why: Earned, visibly protected speed is the #1 movement trend (ULTRAKILL 97% positive on 132k reviews, Haste boosts only on a perfect landing), and a tight timing window with an unmistakable tell is the industry's favourite verb right now (Expedition 33's parry). The Flea puts both into collision itself: the thing every other hull avoids is its engine.

charge.name: Spring
charge.tip: Charge is the energy a perfect bounce returns.

mass.name: Momentum
mass.tip: Mass is how much momentum the hull can hold (the speed cap).

space.name: Big Hop
space.tip: Space is how far a charged hop reaches for the next surface.

styles.name: Balanced
styles.info: Every element at 0: the recipe's numbers.

styles.name: Metronome
styles.info: The widest window: forgiving, for learning the rhythm.

styles.name: Cannonball
styles.info: Big gains and a high cap, the stock window: the expert's chain.

styles.name: Maxed
styles.info: Every element at 10. A ceiling, not a match state.

controls.rt: bounce press (time it to the contact)

notModelled: Bounces reflect off the vector from the prism's centre, not its faces: a lab approximation of a box's normal.
Whether a perfect bounce should mark, shield or break the prism (Mass 5 'Shatter') is a design question; here it only flashes.
sources: Design: Docs/Studios/CONCEPT_FLEET.md (Flea). The platform's hull contact (boost reset, 10% slow) is what a dull bounce replaces.
